checks: The constant scale makes the chart jointly affine and supplies exactly the common fiber Jacobian ell^d. A real section over each point of D contains the prescribed interval, hence at least three integers.

For a closed interval containing m integers, the first and last are m−1 apart and each endpoint adds less than one extra unit. Thus the 3/4 multiple of the length lies between m/2 and m when m is at least three.

Convexity gives interval Minkowski containment and length concavity. Bounded convergent section endpoints give upper semicontinuity by closedness of the charted body, also at boundary points of D. Extension by zero retains upper semicontinuity since D is closed.
The exact counted mixed volume and real-section length are distinct objects throughout. The hypotheses and sandwich are preserved from d8f7a4409a9bdcfe §2.
readability: The concavity assertion is on D. The zero extension is used for the global density and need only be upper semicontinuous.
review_method: Independent cold review of the frozen candidate, with exact arithmetic where applicable and comparison to its original source and pinned dependencies.
summary: The common affine chart gives a genuine concave minorant with pointwise bounds between half the original counting density and the full density.
